'''Sub-Predor''' was a title in the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that ranked below a standard [[Predor]]. [[Ceh'let]] was a Sub-Predor who commanded the [[Battle of Shikaakwa|attack]] on [[Shikaakwa]].
